$comment: Single source of truth for every scanning tool. Nothing here is hardcoded in scripts/ or src/kernel/ — change it once and the ratchet, the prose gate and the lobe reader all follow.

prose.$comment: Scans BOTH authored markdown and the emitted artifact — a claim can reach a reader through a generator that appears in no .md.

claims.pattern: \b(pure consciousness|deterministic enlightenment|consciousness (multiplier|technology)|transformation .{0,40}to pure consciousness|awareness at gateways)\b
\b(particle masses|mₚ/mₑ|spacetime geometry becomes|π (becomes|=) 3\b|perfect fractal ice|no spectral broadening)\b

prose.boundedPattern: \b(refus|boundary|not a claim|no claim|metaphor|analog(y|ies)|overlay, not|is not evidence|does not explain|faithful:|honesty|speculative|hypothes|would need|not measured|unproven|flagged)\b

lobes.$comment: Sibling checkouts read from disk only. Add a lobe by naming it here; no code change required.

limits.$comment: Security bounds. A scanner must not be turned into a memory-exhaustion vector by a large or hostile file.
